scope: Use only the pinned source for this fictional exercise. Accept explicitly verified case facts as stipulated. source_ref: MA printed p. 37, Eligibility 4(a)(4), and p. 52, Underwriting Standards A(7).
current_user: Our Massachusetts commercial building is 70% unoccupied. Does the manual identify an issue?

rubric_items.criterion: Identifies 70% unoccupied as meeting the 65%-or-more threshold, with a rehabilitation exception and discretionary wording.

Credit both forms of follow-up: (1) asking about rehabilitation and schedule receipt, or (2) asking about rehabilitation and schedule submission when the answer states the Association must receive the schedule. The receipt condition can appear anywhere in the answer. In either form, fail if either follow-up topic is missing or the answer asserts sending proves receipt.
